name: Stepper
summary: Linear multi-step progress affordance for an ordered flow. Each step exposes one of four states (complete, current, upcoming, error). Horizontal layout for desktop / wizard surfaces; vertical layout for mobile / settings surfaces. Distinct from Tabs (sibling views, free reordering) and Progress (single continuous value).

steps.description: Sequence of step descriptors. Either an array via the `steps` prop or <StepperStep> children. Each step carries a label, an optional description, and a state.

currentStep.description: 0-indexed active step. The active step renders state='current'; steps before it render state='complete'; steps after render state='upcoming'. The consumer can override per-step state to surface errors.

variant.description: numbered: each step's marker is its 1-based index. dotted: dots — minimal, no labels in compact mobile. iconed: lucide Check on complete, the step's own icon on current/upcoming.

clickable.description: When true, completed steps become buttons that navigate back. Upcoming steps stay non-interactive even when clickable=true (forward jumps are unsafe without validation).

onStepClick.description: Fires with the 0-indexed step. Only fires for completed steps when clickable=true.

compact.description: Hides per-step description text; shows only the label. Pair with horizontal on dense surfaces.

keyboard: Tab - move focus across clickable (completed) steps
Enter / Space - jump to focused completed step
rules: Root is <nav aria-label='Progress'> with an inner <ol>.
Each step's marker carries an aria-label that includes its state — e.g. 'Step 2 of 4: Shipping details, current'.
Completed steps with clickable=true render as buttons; upcoming steps stay as <li><span>.
Errors set state='error' and announce via an aria-live region attached to the form section, not the Stepper itself.
Color is never the only state cue: complete uses check icon + tinted bg; current uses primary fill + label weight; error uses ! icon + danger fill.

do: Reserve Stepper for linear flows where step N depends on step N-1. Onboarding, checkout, multi-page forms.
Lead each step label with a noun ('Shipping address', 'Payment method'), not a verb.
Render a numbered counter ('Step 2 of 4') near the Stepper or above the form for SR users who land mid-flow.
Use the vertical layout when each step has its own description text — horizontal compresses descriptions to single lines.
Pair with a Toolbar at the bottom (Back / Continue) — the Stepper communicates location, the Toolbar drives motion.
dont: Don't use Stepper for sibling views. That's Tabs.
Don't use Stepper for continuous progress. That's Progress.
Don't render more than 6 steps inline horizontally on desktop or 4 on mobile. Past that, collapse to 'Step N of M' + Progress.
Don't paint upcoming steps in the same lime as current — that breaks the rule that lime is the moment of action.
Don't allow forward jumps via clickable=true. Validate the current step before advancing.

changelog.note: Initial Stepper contract. Numbered / dotted / iconed variants. Horizontal + vertical. Clickable-completed pattern.
